chunks: 3057 - Al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام was asked about the atonement for hunted game: may its owner eat from its meat? He said:
"He eats from his sacrificial offering and gives the atonement in charity."
ai.seo_question: Can a person eat from the meat of the sacrificial offering given as atonement for hunted game?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the fidāʾ for hunted game. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that the person may eat from his sacrificial offering, while the fidāʾ itself is to be given in charity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3057 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about the atonement for hunting: can the individual eat from its meat?
Imam (as) replied: "He eats from his sacrificial offering and gives the atonement in charity."
